description:
Csat Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wurm, adding {G}.

Repeat.
